subject: Kickoff: Apr 12 Field Summit — livestream integration, sponsor watermarks & fallback plan
messages:
From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: operations@vividcast.co
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: Apr 12 Field Summit — livestream integration, sponsor watermarks & fallback plan

Hi Alex / VividCast team,

Thanks for agreeing to support the Field Summit livestream on Apr 12. We want to lock down the integration checklist and a clear fallback so our sponsors (and legal) have confidence in recording delivery and brand protection. Action items / asks to start: 

- Encoder/ingest: please send the RTMP/SRT endpoints, credential rotation cadence, and a short how-to for our AV partner to push primary + backup streams.
- Registrant mapping: we need a persistent registrant_id in the webhook payload so we can join engagement data to HubSpot. Confirm field name and sample payload.
- Sponsor watermarking: sponsors require a single-frame dynamic watermark on their sponsored segments (lower-third with sponsor logo + sponsor id). Can VividCast apply per-segment watermark stamps in the live recording export? If not, confirm that we can ingest individual sponsor clip exports for post-processing.
- Recording retention & access: default 48h retention won't be enough — Marketing asks for 90 days for sponsor review. Please indicate whether we can set project-level retention to 90 days and provide S3 export links for downloaded clips.
- Pre-record options: some speakers will submit pre-recorded content. Need guidance for ingest + stitching.
- Test windows: propose two 90-minute test windows during Apr 6–8 (prefer morning PDT). Include a plan for an audio-only mic check and a presenter-facing playback check.

I've attached the latest run-of-show (run-of-show_v2.pdf) and included the HubSpot deal link for reference.

Can you confirm the above and attach your encoder instructions? Also include a short checklist we can share with sponsors for logo assets (formats/safe area).

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Field Events Lead | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0189

Attachments: run-of-show_v2.pdf (PDF)

From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@vividcast.co>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 12:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Apr 12 Field Summit — livestream integration, sponsor watermarks & fallback plan

Hi Laura — great to kick this off. Quick confirmations below and a few clarifying Qs.

1) Encoder/ingest: we support RTMP + SRT. See attached quick-start for your AV team (vividcast_encoder_creds_instructions.txt). We recommend primary RTMP -> VividCast and SRT fallback to our edge for glitch resilience. Credential rotation: we support per-event keys that can be rotated hourly if required.

2) Registrant mapping: we can pass through a registrant_id in webhook (field: registrant.external_id). We'll attach a sample payload in the test plan.

3) Sponsor watermarking: we have a live-stamp feature that can overlay a static PNG per timestamp segment. For dynamic lower-thirds with sponsor logos per segment we can apply during live export, but for the highest fidelity we recommend exporting per-sponsor clips server-side and applying frame-accurate watermarks as part of post. We can automate clip export per sponsor tag.

4) Retention: default project retention is 48 hours; we can extend to 90 days on a per-project basis for an additional storage fee. We can also provide S3 presigned export links for each clip.

5) Pre-recorded content: accepted via a secure ingest portal (we'll include a link in the test plan). Stitching support is available; we recommend MP4 h264 baseline profile.

6) Tests: we propose two 90-minute windows: Apr 6 09:30–11:00 PDT and Apr 7 10:00–11:30 PDT. We'll run an AV mic check (presenter mic + backup phone dial-in), encoder failover simulation, and a sponsor-clip export test.

We can provide a test-plan PDF by end of day with sample payloads and a detailed checklist for sponsor assets. Any compliance constraints (e.g., retention longer than 90 days) we should loop in your security team.

Best,
Alex Wu
Technical Program Manager | VividCast
alex.wu@vividcast.co

Attachments: vividcast_encoder_creds_instructions.txt (text)

From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Apr 12 Field Summit — livestream integration, sponsor watermarks & fallback plan

Laura / team —

Thanks Alex — a few notes from ops and sponsor programs: 

- Sponsor compliance: we must include a short SLA in the sponsor contract about clip delivery timing and watermark fidelity. Marketing insists on per-sponsor clip exports within 24 hours of event close. Please ask VividCast if automated clip tagging can be triggered by timestamps in the run-of-show.
- Fallback / failover: confirm SRT fallback behavior and whether our Dedicated encoder can knob down bitrate automatically to preserve continuity (we do not want long outages). Also confirm if VividCast rotates keys automatically during rotation window — we prefer a rolling swap rather than a hard cut.
- Registrant PII: we need the minimal required fields. If VividCast's webhook includes email addresses, make sure we document retention windows and opt-out flows.

I'll draft the sponsor contract addendum and share a redline. If Mina (security) can confirm the retention extension cost + audit trail, we can finalize.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Events Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

Cc: alex.wu@vividcast.co, operations@vividcast.co, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 15:10:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Kickoff: retention + registrant PII minimization — need quick sign-off

Mina — forwarding the thread. We need a quick confirmation on two points so we can give VividCast a go: 

- Retention: Marketing requests a 90-day retention for sponsor review. VividCast can enable this for a fee; is that acceptable from a controls/audit perspective (S3 presigned export + audit logs)?
- Registrant payload: VividCast will send registrant.external_id and optionally email. We want to avoid storing emails on the event export layer; can we ingest only the external_id and map to HubSpot server-side? Also, please note sponsors will request clip access — what auth pattern should we use?

If you can reply with short answers we can include them in the service appendix. Alex — feel free to chime in on any security details.

Thanks,
Laura

Attachment: (none)

From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@vividcast.co>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, mina.haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: operations@vividcast.co, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Kickoff: retention + registrant PII minimization — need quick sign-off

Thanks Laura / Mina — quick replies: 

- Retention: we can enable 90-day retention and provide S3 presigned exports. All exports include standard audit logs (export time, actor, file checksums). We'll include export event IDs to help with your audit trail. There is a small storage uplift; we will send a quote in the test plan PDF.

- Registrant payload & PII: we can omit email from the webhook on request and only send registrant.external_id. HubSpot mapping can be done on your server. For sponsor clip access, recommend sending a presigned S3 URL and a one-time token; we can also gate access by a signed claim that your team issues to sponsor portals.

I've attached a fuller test plan that includes the sample webhook payload, the proposed test windows, and a sponsor asset checklist. Please review and confirm the Apr 6/7 test windows.

Best,
Alex

Attachments: vividcast_test-plan_20270410.pdf (PDF)
